import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MODULO = 1000000007;
    static int p_input, k_input, answer_value;
    static boolean[] visited_flags;

    static int solve() {
        answer_value = 1;
        if (k_input == 0) {
            for (int i = 1; i < p_input; ++i) {
                answer_value = (int)((long)answer_value * p_input % MODULO);
            }
        } else if (k_input == 1) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= p_input; ++i) {
                answer_value = (int)((long)answer_value * p_input % MODULO);
            }
        } else {
            for (int i = 0; i < p_input; ++i) {
                if (!visited_flags[i]) {
                    int cycle_length = 0;
                    int index = i;
                    while (!visited_flags[index]) {
                        visited_flags[index] = true;
                        ++cycle_length;
                        index = (int)((long)index * k_input % p_input);
                    }
                    if (index != 0) {
                        answer_value = (int)((long)answer_value * p_input % MODULO);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return answer_value;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        p_input = scanner.nextInt();
        k_input = scanner.nextInt();
        visited_flags = new boolean[p_input];
        System.out.println(solve());
        scanner.close();
    }
}
